+## #2860 - Adaptive roughing and Pocket finishing
+
+**What was decided:** Add an original U-shaped pocket with one open end.
+Use 2D Adaptive before 2D Pocket through the existing commands.
+Adaptive leaves a nominal 0.5 mm wall allowance and stops 0.5 mm above the floor.
+Pocket uses zero wall allowance and reaches the model floor.
+Keep the case-specific pin in a separate test file.
+
+**Why:** The case demonstrates roughing followed by finishing with explicit stock allowances.
+The existing commands can generate, verify, save, and post the example.
+A separate test avoids extending the shared catalog test beyond its existing 431 lines and avoids overlaps with open PRs.
+
+**Considered and dropped:** A closed pocket would not meet the open-pocket requirement.
+Rest machining is not needed to demonstrate this sequence.
+Algorithm changes are not needed because the existing APIs provide the required behavior.
+Extending the shared catalog test would increase its length and create overlap with other work.
+
+**Verification scope:** Verification checks for gouges, rather than complete stock removal.
+The cutter leaves material in the model's sharp inside corners.
+Adaptive also reports up to 0.71 mm of extra corner scallop beyond the nominal wall allowance.
+The case README states these limits.
+
+**Cost to change later:** Regenerate the mesh, project, and NC program.
+Update the pinning test and the README to match the new geometry or allowances.

+# Adaptive roughing and Pocket finishing
+
+This original case shows 2D Adaptive roughing followed by 2D Pocket finishing.
+The stock is a 60 × 40 × 12 mm box, centered in X and Y, with its bottom at Z0.
+The model has a U-shaped pocket with a floor at Z6 and an open end at X30.
+The pocket spans X−10 to X30 and Y−10 to Y10.
+
+Both operations use the 6 mm flat end mill `EM-0600-4FL`, without a holder.
+Both select the recognized pocket floor.
+The imported mesh is embedded in the project, so reopening it requires no external model path.
+
+| Order | Operation | Wall stock | Bottom Z | Purpose |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| 1 | `Adaptive rough` — 2D Adaptive | 0.5 mm | 6.5 mm | Leave 0.5 mm on the walls and floor. |
+| 2 | `Pocket finish` — 2D Pocket, `offset_rings` | 0 mm | 6 mm | Remove the wall and floor allowances. |
+
+The roughing floor allowance comes from the explicit bottom height of Z6.5.
+`stock_to_leave` sets the radial wall allowance.
+Adaptive rounds the wall corners and reports up to 0.71 mm of extra corner scallop beyond the nominal 0.5 mm wall allowance.
+Pocket finishing recuts the full selected pocket region; this case does not use rest machining.
+
+Inspect the operation order and the different bottom heights in the project and NC program.
+Compare the Adaptive passes with the Pocket offset rings.
+Check that the roughing operation stops above the floor and that finishing reaches Z6.
+The 6 mm cutter leaves material in the model's sharp inside corners.
+A clean verification result checks for gouges; it does not prove that all unwanted stock is removed.
+
+Regenerate the original mesh from this case's `model/` directory:
+
+```sh
+python3 gen_adaptive_pocket_obj.py
+```
+
+Rebuild the project and NC program from the repository root:
+
+```sh
+cargo xtask catalog --case 2d/adaptive-pocket
+```
+
+`build.camscript` generates both operations, verifies them, saves `adaptive-pocket.camproj`, and posts `adaptive-pocket.nc`.
+The generator checks that its mesh is watertight and consistently oriented before writing it.

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+# Provenance: original box-grid boundary mesh using the repository fixture method.
+"""Generate the watertight U-shaped open pocket; no third-party geometry."""
+
+import sys
+
+PLANES = [[-30.0, -10.0, 30.0], [-20.0, -10.0, 10.0, 20.0], [0.0, 6.0, 12.0]]
+
+
+def solid(p):
+    # Remove the upper middle cell through the positive-X edge.
+    return not (p[0] > -10.0 and -10.0 < p[1] < 10.0 and p[2] > 6.0)
+
+
+def build():
+    dims = [len(p) - 1 for p in PLANES]
+    inside = set()
+    for i in range(dims[0]):
+        for j in range(dims[1]):
+            for k in range(dims[2]):
+                mid = [(PLANES[a][idx] + PLANES[a][idx + 1]) / 2
+                       for a, idx in enumerate((i, j, k))]
+                if solid(tuple(mid)):
+                    inside.add((i, j, k))
+
+    groups = {}
+    for cell in inside:
+        for axis in range(3):
+            for sign in (+1, -1):
+                nxt = list(cell)
+                nxt[axis] += sign
+                if tuple(nxt) in inside:
+                    continue
+                plane = cell[axis] + (1 if sign > 0 else 0)
+                a, b = (d for d in range(3) if d != axis)
+                groups.setdefault((axis, plane, sign, a, b), set()).add(
+                    (cell[a], cell[b]))
+
+    # with a, b the other two axes in ascending order, walking (a then b)
+    # gives a normal of +axis for axis 0 and 2 and -axis for axis 1
+    # (hat{x} x hat{z} = -hat{y}), so check that sign before emitting
+    WALK_SIGN = {0: +1, 1: -1, 2: +1}
+    quads = []  # each a list of 4 (x, y, z) coordinate tuples, oriented
+    for (axis, plane, sign, a, b), cells in groups.items():
+        for (ca, cb) in sorted(cells):  # unit quads tile each plane exactly,
+            quad = []                   # from both sides, so no T-junctions
+            for p, q in [(ca, cb), (ca + 1, cb), (ca + 1, cb + 1), (ca, cb + 1)]:
+                pos = [None, None, None]
+                pos[axis] = PLANES[axis][plane]
+                pos[a] = PLANES[a][p]
+                pos[b] = PLANES[b][q]
+                quad.append(tuple(pos))
+            if WALK_SIGN[axis] != sign:
+                quad.reverse()
+            quads.append(quad)
+    return quads
+
+
+def check(quads):
+    """Watertight and consistently oriented: every directed edge appears
+    exactly once and its reverse appears exactly once."""
+    seen = {}
+    for quad in quads:
+        for p, q in zip(quad, quad[1:] + quad[:1]):
+            if p == q:
+                raise SystemExit("degenerate quad: %r" % (quad,))
+            if (p, q) in seen:
+                raise SystemExit("directed edge reused: %r -> %r" % (p, q))
+            seen[(p, q)] = True
+    for (p, q) in seen:
+        if (q, p) not in seen:
+            raise SystemExit("open edge: %r -> %r" % (p, q))
+
+
+def main():
+    out = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "adaptive-pocket.obj"
+    quads = build()
+    check(quads)
+
+    vid = {}
+    vlines = []
+    for quad in quads:
+        for p in quad:
+            if p not in vid:
+                vid[p] = len(vlines) + 1
+                vlines.append("v %g %g %g" % p)
+    flines = []
+    for quad in quads:
+        flines.append("f " + " ".join(str(vid[p]) for p in quad))
+
+    with open(out, "w") as fh:
+        fh.write(HEADER)
+        fh.write("\n" + "\n".join(vlines) + "\n\n" + "\n".join(flines) + "\n")
+    print("wrote %s: %d vertices, %d faces" % (out, len(vlines), len(flines)))
+
+
+HEADER = "# Original CamCraft open pocket: 60 x 40 x 12 mm, floor Z6, open at X30."
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
